blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 40-year-old father and his 22-year-old daughter were found dead inside their home in General Mariano Alvarez, Cavite, on Sunday afternoon, police said. The wife and mother of the victims, who was working in Manila, asked her sister at 3 p.m. to check on the two after they repeatedly failed to answer her phone calls, the Calabarzon police said in a report on Monday. The sister proceeded to the victims’ residence in Barangay Delas Alas and called out several times from outside the house but received no response.
